services.name: frontend
services.description: Exposes HTTP server serving the website and reverse-proxies gRPC calls to internal services.

services.name: cartservice
services.description: Stores user shopping cart items in Redis datastore and provides cart modification APIs.

services.name: productcatalogservice
services.description: Provides product search, details, and list APIs reading from catalog JSON.

services.name: currencyservice
services.description: Converts currency amounts between different international currencies based on current exchange rates.

services.name: paymentservice
services.description: Charges customer credit cards and processes payment authorization with mock merchant provider.

services.name: shippingservice
services.description: Gives shipping quotes and ships orders based on mock address and items count.

services.name: emailservice
services.description: Sends customer confirmation emails upon successful order placement.

services.name: checkoutservice
services.description: Coordinates cart retrieval, payment processing, shipping quote, order preparation, and notification.

services.name: recommendationservice
services.description: Recommends other products to browse based on current cart contents.

services.name: adservice
services.description: Serves targeted contextual advertisements based on current browsing category.

services.name: loadgenerator
services.description: Continuously generates synthetic realistic traffic against frontend web service.

services.name: redis-cart
services.description: In-memory key-value cache datastore storing persistent session carts for cartservice.
